netflix.title: The Last House
netflix.overview: A family suddenly sealed inside their home must work together to survive against dwindling resources and the ominous threat keeping them trapped.

netflix.title: Mary Beth Barone: Galaxy Brain
netflix.overview: This marks Mary Beth Barone's first hour-long comedy special.

amazon-prime-video.title: The Devil's Mouth
amazon-prime-video.overview: A group of college friends' Thailand adventure turns deadly when they become trapped in submerged caves with a dangerous predator. As oxygen runs low, past conflicts emerge in their desperate fight for survival.

amazon-prime-video.title: Adarsh Baal Vidyalaya
amazon-prime-video.overview: A relaxed principal tries to reform a failing public school, triggering a messy transformation as misfit teachers work to repair the system one lesson at a time.

apple-tv.title: The Dynasty: UConn Huskies
apple-tv.overview: Explores the history and the recent win by UConn Huskies Women's Basketball team of the 2025 NCAA National Championship, through a mix of archival footage and interviews.

apple-tv.title: Snoopy Presents: There's No Place Like Home, Snoopy
apple-tv.overview: When Snoopy's beloved doghouse goes missing, he tries to track it down, and learns what makes a house feel like home.

disney-plus.title: 2026 Disney Legends Awards Ceremony Live!
disney-plus.overview: Live from Anaheim, California, the Disney Legends Awards Ceremony at “D23: The Ultimate Disney Fan Event” celebrates an extraordinary class of Disney Legends receiving the company’s highest honor. Honorees include Chris Berman, Jerry Bruckheimer, Susan Egan, Eric Goldberg, Anne Hathaway, Bob Iger, Kim Irvine, Dwayne Johnson, the Jonas Brothers, Lin‑Manuel Miranda, and Alan Tudyk. Hosted by Emmy® Award-winning Ryan Seacrest, this unforgettable ceremony features heartfelt tributes, surprise moments, and inspiring stories honoring the icons whose creativity, talent, and vision have shaped Disney magic for generations.

skyshowtime.title: Avatar Aang: The Last Airbender
skyshowtime.overview: Avatar Aang, the world's last Airbender, learns of an ancient power that could save his culture from extinction. With the help of his friends, he embarks on a global quest to find it before it falls into the wrong hands.

hbo-max.title: Whitmer Thomas: Terminal Crew of Dudes
hbo-max.overview: Comedian, musician, and actor Whitmer Thomas digs into his small-town Alabama upbringing and his ongoing quest to be cool.

hbo-max.title: The Sex Slave
hbo-max.overview: A harrowing two-part documentary chronicling how a mother of five suddenly found herself being sold to unknown men... by her own partner.

hbo-max.title: The Invisible Guest
hbo-max.overview: Accused of murdering her lover, a young businesswoman hires a brilliant lawyer. With only three hours left, they must uncover what really happened.

bloodstream.title: Together Till the End
bloodstream.overview: When a young couple is about to go out on a trip, something gets in their way: the zombie apocalypse.

bloodstream.title: Evil Follows
bloodstream.overview: A husband's fight to save his wife from a demonic possession that began the moment the dybbuk box chose her as its next host.

kableone.title: The Great Punjab Robbery
kableone.overview: Three robbers with strange names seize an ordinary bank in Punjab. No demands. No ransom. Just cryptic riddles sent to the cops, each one leading deeper into the mystery.
